{{Top|leg|canon=Vagaari pod}}
'''Zero-g plastic bubbles''' lined the outer [[Hull/Legends|hull]] plates of [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] [[Warship/Legends|warships]] and with a [[Geroon (species)|Geroon]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] held inside each one, acted as a [[living shield]]. About twice the size of a [[Human/Legends|Human]] coffin, each bubble had an air supply, a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] and a very clear view of the ensuing battle.

A [[Unidentified Miskara (Jorj Car'das)|Miskara]] placed [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jorj Car'das]] in one of the many zero-g plastic bubbles mounted to the outer hull of his Vagaari flagship, just prior to his defeat by the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]] in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].
